description.value: Chilcotin's Waterfront Resort & Motel sits on the shore of Nimpo Lake in the remote West Chilcotin, offering log cabins built by TV-featured Timber Kings, lakeside motel units, and RV sites with mountain and lake views. It operates year-round, drawing visitors for summer fishing and floatplanes as well as winter snowmobiling in the Rainbow Mountains. For a touring cyclist passing through one of BC's most isolated regions, this is a rare full-service accommodation stop with diverse lodging options.

address.value: 1874 Otter Road, Nimpo Lake, BC V0L 1R0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was successfully fetched and confirms the resort is open year-round offering cabins, motel units, and RV sites on Nimpo Lake. Cabin one explicitly mentions a washer and dryer, and the RV page references the nearby Nimpo Lake General Store for food and supplies. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, Wi-Fi, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all bike-related criteria remain null. The website's footer lists a different canonical URL (www.nimpolakewaterfront.ca) than the OSM-recorded URL, which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Website canonical URL listed in site footer (www.nimpolakewaterfront.ca) differs from the OSM-recorded URL (nimpolakewaterfrontresort.com); both may be active but the authoritative domain is unclear.
No mention of Wi-Fi anywhere on the site; motel units only list satellite TV, which may indicate limited connectivity at this remote location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operating accommodation in a remote cycling corridor, but the website contains no evidence of any cycling-specific amenities, including the required secure bike storage. Direct outreach is needed to confirm whether the property can meet WWC required criteria.
enrichment_extras.notes: The summer activities page briefly mentions mountain biking ('Explore the mountains on foot, on horseback, ATV or mountain bike'), suggesting cycling is a recognised area activity, but no cyclist-specific services are described at the resort itself.

Laundry.detail: Cabin one is described as having a washer and dryer on the cabins page
